name: Tavley Restaurant Booking
author: mediazet

sections.description:
Tavley turns your WordPress site into your restaurant’s booking system: customers pick date, shift, party size and their table on your floor-plan image — you control everything from the dashboard. With the separate Tavley PRO add-on you also get a visual room designer, table QR codes, a waitlist and recurring bookings.

Features

  • Public booking form: date, shift and number of guests
  • Table map on your own floor-plan image: upload a photo/plan and place tables with drag & drop — customers pick their table when booking
  • Sample floor plan included so you can start right away
  • Round, square or rectangular tables with chairs drawn around them
  • Copy/Paste tables in the map editor (Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V / Ctrl+D)
  • Big responsive booking map that fills the card edge-to-edge
  • With multiple rooms the table label shows the room name everywhere (“Tavolo 6 · Sala 2”)
  • Lunch shift and weekly closing days
  • Coupon and birthday fields already in the form
  • Anti-fake email verification
  • Automatic confirmation and cancellation emails
  • Booking states, full history and archive
  • Period filters: today, 7 and 30 days, custom range
  • Customer search in history
  • Staff App for waiters (PIN, today’s arrivals, check-in, search)
  • Setup wizard and built-in diagnostics
  • Rules: min/max advance notice, custom booking page URL and dashboard logo
  • Admin bookings calendar: month grid with covers, pending and closed days at a glance — click a day for the full detail
  • CSV export of bookings (respects the active date filters)
  • Self-service booking edit: guests can change date, time, party size and notes from the link in their confirmation email, with the same availability rules as a new booking

Tavley PRO (separate add-on plugin)

An optional paid extension, sold separately at https://wptavley.mediazet.it/, adds:

  • PRO Medium — Visual room designer: draw your own dining room with walls, tables, text and placeable chairs/armchairs (1 room); copy/paste on tables, shapes and elements for fast editing; table QR codes: guests scan to see the menu and call the waiter (calls arrive in the Staff App with sound and acknowledge/complete states); waitlist: when a shift is fully booked guests can join a list and are emailed automatically on a cancellation; multi-location: run several restaurant locations from one site, each with its own rooms and tables — guests pick the location first in the booking form; custom form fields (allergies, occasions, GDPR consent — up to 8, required/optional, shown in the booking list and CSV export); post-dinner follow-up email (thank-you + review link, sent automatically N days after dinner); closure reasons shown to customers and in the calendar; advanced calendar: week view with drag & drop rescheduling and printable/PDF month list
  • PRO Max — everything in Medium plus: Stripe deposits (customer pays a deposit via secure Stripe Checkout before the booking is confirmed, automatic refund on cancellation, per-person or per-booking amount, large-groups-only option); unlimited rooms and full editor tools (polygons, ellipses, doors, windows, zones, rotation); recurring reservations for regular customers (e.g. every Tuesday at 8 pm, generated automatically); floor-plan export to PNG and print; multiple image floor plans; kitchen orders: live kitchen monitor and 80mm ticket printing for every table order; advanced analytics: occupancy heatmap, covers forecast and a no-show risk score on upcoming bookings
  • Multiple shifts (dinner 1, dinner 2) and optional Night Shift
  • Extraordinary closures (holidays, vacations)
  • Marketing & automatic coupons (birthday themes, win-back campaigns)
  • Anti no-show reminders (daily automatic sending)
  • Table orders and consumption tracking
  • Full reports and analytics (30-day covers chart)
  • Newsletter & Landing Page builder
  • AI assistant (with your own API key)
  • SEO & Schema.org tools (Open Graph, FAQ, geo, llms.txt)
  • Ticket support inside the plugin

PRO plans: PRO Medium (yearly license) and PRO Max (lifetime license). The free plugin is fully functional without them.

Official site: https://wptavley.mediazet.it/ — Demo: https://demo-wptavley.mediazet.it/

External Services

This plugin communicates with the Tavley server (wptavley.mediazet.it) in the following cases:

  • Telemetry (optional, explicit consent only) — if you accept the “share statistics” admin banner, the plugin sends a daily ping with site domain, plugin version, plan and admin email. No content, customer data or bookings are ever sent. Can be disabled anytime in Tavley → Settings.
  • License validation (only with the separate Tavley PRO plugin installed) — the PRO add-on validates license keys by sending key and site domain to the Tavley license server at https://wptavley.mediazet.it/ (REST endpoint /wp-json/tly/v1/license).
  • Ticket support (only with PRO active) — support requests sent from the PRO Support menu transmit license key, domain, name, email, message and diagnostic data to the Tavley support server at https://wptavley.mediazet.it/ (REST endpoint /wp-json/tly/v1/support).

Terms of Service: https://wptavley.mediazet.it/termini-e-condizioni/ — Privacy Policy: https://wptavley.mediazet.it/privacy-policy/
* AI assistant (only with PRO active, optional) — if you configure your own API key, questions and the venue profile are sent to the AI provider endpoint you configured (e.g. Groq https://api.groq.com or OpenAI https://api.openai.com). Disabled until a key is entered. Groq terms: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/ — OpenAI terms: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

No other external calls are made.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tavley-restaurant-booking folder to /wp-content/plugins/ (or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload)
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Follow the setup wizard, publish the booking page and you are ready for reservations
  4. Optional: buy Tavley PRO at https://wptavley.mediazet.it/, upload the tavley-pro zip as a second plugin and enter your license key in the PRO License page
sections.faq:
Does the free version work without a license key?

Yes. The free plugin is a complete product: the booking form, lunch shift, weekly closing days, emails, history and Staff App work out of the box with no limits.

How do I get PRO?

Buy it at https://wptavley.mediazet.it/ — you receive a tavley-pro.zip plugin and a license key by email. Install it next to the free plugin, activate it and paste the key.

Does the license work on multiple sites?

One key = one site. To move it: deactivate on the old site, activate on the new one.

Do I need a developer to install it?

No: it installs like any WordPress plugin and the setup wizard walks you to your first booking.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. The booking form drops into any page via shortcode or block and adapts to your theme. No coding needed.

Can customers pick a specific table?

Yes. Upload a photo or plan of your dining room in Map & Tables, drag the tables into place, and guests pick their table on that image when booking. With the Tavley PRO add-on they can also pick a room and you can draw the floor plan instead of uploading a photo.

What are table QR codes (PRO)?

A PRO Medium feature: print a QR for each table, guests scan it to see your menu and press “Call the waiter” — the request rings in the Staff App, the waiter acknowledges it and the guest sees “The waiter is coming”.

How does the waitlist work (PRO)?

When a shift is fully booked the form offers “Put me on the waitlist”. On a cancellation the first guest in line is emailed automatically and can confirm from the email link within 48 hours.

What are recurring reservations (PRO)?

A PRO Max feature: create a rule like “Mr. White, every Tuesday at 8 pm, 4 guests” and the plugin generates the bookings automatically, without duplicates. If the table is taken that day, the booking is created anyway for you to assign later.

How does multi-location work (PRO)?

A PRO Medium feature: add a location for each restaurant you run, assign each room to a location, and guests pick the location first in the booking form — they only see that location’s tables. One site, one customer database, stats per location.

What do kitchen orders look like (PRO)?

A PRO Max feature: orders written on a booking become kitchen tickets on a live monitor (auto-refreshing) and can be printed on any printer including 80mm receipt printers.

What are the advanced analytics (PRO)?

A PRO Max feature: an occupancy heatmap (which days/hours fill up), a 14-day covers forecast based on recent history, and a traffic-light no-show risk score on upcoming bookings so you know who to call.
sections.changelog:
2.2

  • New: admin bookings calendar — month grid with confirmed/pending covers per day, closed days highlighted, click any day for the full booking detail with quick actions
  • New: CSV export of bookings from the All Bookings and History pages — respects the active period/date filters, UTF-8 BOM + semicolon separator so it opens perfectly in Excel
  • New: self-service booking edit — the confirmation email now includes a “Modify booking” button: guests can change date, time, party size and notes themselves, with the same availability rules as a new booking (shift validity, closing days, advance notice, table capacity, table conflicts)
  • New extension hooks for add-ons: wptb_booking_form_extra + wptb_booking_validate (extra form fields), wptb_export_csv_headers / wptb_export_csv_row (extra CSV columns), wptb_impostazioni_extra (settings sections), wptb_messaggio_chiusura + wptb_motivo_chiusura (closure reasons), wptb_calendario_custom_view + wptb_calendario_toolbar (calendar views), wptb_prenotazione_flusso_custom (alternative booking flows such as payment)
  • Fixed: duplicate calendar submenu entry
  • Minor: jQuery .click() shorthand replaced with .on('click') for jQuery 4 / WordPress 7.2 readiness

2.1

  • New: table map on your own floor-plan image — upload a photo/plan and place tables with drag & drop, guests pick their table when booking
  • New: sample floor plan bundled with the plugin — a ready-made dining room to start from
  • New: table shapes — round, square (chairs on all 4 sides) or rectangular
  • New: copy/paste tables in the map editor (Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V / Ctrl+D) plus Delete-key removal
  • New: bigger fully-responsive public booking map — fills the card edge-to-edge, no stretching
  • New: with multiple rooms the table label shows the room name (“Tavolo 6 · Sala 2”) in emails, booking lists, Staff App, kitchen tickets and QR waiter calls
  • Fixed: public floor-plan SVG could appear stretched under some themes — aspect ratio is now enforced
  • Fixed: birthday-coupon email link could reach the booking page without the coupon parameter — links in custom templates are rewritten with coupon + customer token, and malformed “?couponCODE” links are repaired
  • Fixed: birthday-coupon automation could die on strict MySQL when filtering empty birthday dates
  • Fixed: constant redefinition warnings when Tavley PRO is active alongside this plugin
  • The visual floor-plan editor now lives only in the separate Tavley PRO add-on (basic editor on one room in Medium, full editor and multiple rooms in Max); this plugin keeps bookings without table assignment and exposes the wptb_wizard_fine hook
  • Multiple rooms/floor plans are now provided by the separate Tavley PRO add-on (via the wptb_mappa_nuova_sala action and the wptb:tabs_rendered JS hook); this plugin manages a single room
  • Extra shifts, night shift and extraordinary closures are now provided by the separate Tavley PRO add-on (via filters/actions); this plugin keeps the lunch shift and weekly closing days
  • Removed all consumption/order management code from this plugin (it now lives only in the separate Tavley PRO add-on, via the new wptb_booking_row_actions and wptb_booking_modals action hooks)
  • Security: nonce verification added to Staff App write endpoints and to saved sort preferences
  • New extension hooks for add-ons: wptb_booking_form_top (booking form), wptb_sale_frontend + wptb_sala_iniziale_frontend (front-end room list), wptb_prenotazione_creata (fires after a booking is saved)

2.0

  • First-run setup wizard
  • Staff App (PWA)
  • Visual floor-plan editor with rooms, shapes, doors, windows and zones
  • PRO features moved to the separate “Tavley Restaurant Booking PRO” plugin
